wordRanking: First 5,000 supported unique modern dictionary headwords in the Basic Korean Vocabulary List order; homographs merged. A selected learner-list ranking, not a universal usage ranking.
wordLicense: Wiktionary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0. Adapted English glosses; source entry is https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/<word>#Korean. History at the same URL with action=history. Dictionary extracted by Kaikki/Wiktextract.
symbolPractice: All 40 letters first, then weighted review to 500. Weights count letters inside syllables of the OpenSubtitles Korean surface-token frequency list, including final consonants. Romanization is an approximation; sounds depend on context.
editorialReview: Automated exclusion of inflections/nonmodern senses; explicit common-word gloss corrections. Complete deck is not native-speaker certified.
